Open: whether to record the Perpetual Adoration Chapel (24/7 per the website) at the church.

sources.said: PERPETUAL EUCHARISTIC ADORATION CHAPEL Email: Adoration@sjanj.net Visit: sjanj.net/pea
PERPETUAL EUCHARISTIC ADORATION CHAPEL Email: Adoration@sjanj.net Visit: sjanj.net/pea
Perpetual Adoration 24 hours a day
Our Perpetual Adoration Chapel has been in operation non-stop since December 8, 1996

slots.rationale: R30, R38, R6: both bulletins advertise the parish's Perpetual Eucharistic Adoration Chapel (sign up for a weekly holy hour) but print no hours or location; the parish website says 'Perpetual Adoration 24 hours a day', 'non-stop since December 8, 1996', with a sign-up list updated 9/17/2026, and calls it 'St. John the Apostle's Adoration Chapel'. This one-church parish gives only 1805 Penbrook Terrace, but no source says outright that the chapel is at the church. Leaning include, 00:00-23:59 each day as other 24/7 chapels are recorded.
slots.question: Record the Perpetual Eucharistic Adoration Chapel as Adoration all day, every day (00:00-23:59) at St. John the Apostle Church?
